:::{#exr-indicator-vector-practice}
#### Encoding the second of four categories as an indicator vector

One-hot encoding stores a value that falls in one of $p$ categories
as the [indicator vector](#def-indicator-vector) of its category.
A survey answer falls in the second of $4$ categories.

Find $\vecf{e}_2$ with $4$ entries,
the one-hot encoding of that answer.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

By @def-indicator-vector,
$\vecf{e}_2$ has a $1$ in position $2$ and $0$s elsewhere.

:::
